correctness_before_timing: On the same pinned native checkpoint, compare unchanged-reference and integrated candidate on fresh caches and deterministic baseline token trajectories. Retain logits/output tokens, numerical comparisons, shapes/dtypes and routing-related mismatches. Passing isolated checks is not full-model correctness.
integration: Trusted controller temporarily replaces only the native expert class call during candidate requests. Intercept supported BF16 single-token expert input; call the original method directly for prefill/unsupported shapes to prevent fallback recursion. Restore the exact original method between candidate and baseline requests and on every exit. No source-file mutation.
measurement: Materialize native model one tensor at a time on CPU outside timing. Use matched request driver, candidate snapshot, current protected/runtime/checkpoint identity. Fresh20-pair A/A confidence calibration before matched20-pair baseline/candidate comparisons with five warmups; preserve fixed per-request controls and paging-aware policy. Do not compare new candidate against historical baseline numbers. No old failed calibration relabeled.
prerequisite: Independent native/tiny checks and reliable positive operator results with valid A/A, environment and integrity on layers0,12,23. An exploratory multi-candidate shortlist is not independent confirmation.
reporting: Only valid fresh full-model results can support a speedup statement. No ACCEPTED verdict or task-quality claim: acceptance remains disabled and held-out task gate remains planned.
